name: Vital Pumpgrip
description: Gather qi at the breech through a long breath so the spread has force held in reserve.

name: Facetpellet
description: Plant the rear foot and lock the hips so a heavy qi spread does not rock the frame.

name: Blaze Slug
description: Fire a fan of qi-driven pellets across the knot of foes before the muzzle.

name: Might Doublebarrel
description: Weave sideways between shots while the hands recharge by feel alone.

name: Wad Torment
description: Draw the weight of the fan into its core so qi drives a narrow plug through armour.

name: Torrent Breech
description: Fire a short spread at a lunging blade so the blast knocks its point wide.

name: Scything Buckshot Maelstrom
description: Release a full qi charge so the fan breaks a shield line and strikes the ranks behind it.

name: Harpooning Slugchamber
description: Pack qi behind the pellets to punch one dense plug through a guard and the body behind it.

name: Chime Sawnedge
description: Study each shot's holes in a plank and note how far the pattern shattered it.

name: Equipoise Shell
description: Shape the pellet load with qi so each piece keeps its place within the pattern.

name: Blaze Spreadshot
description: Fire a shaped load at brittle cover so the pattern shatters it into flying splinters.

name: Bounding Pump
description: Walk the muzzle across a long line while stepping so the pattern sweeps it clean.

name: Aegis Choke
description: Hold a crouch behind cover while qi hardens the hide against splinters and the recharge goes on.

name: Grinding Bead
description: Fire into timber so a cloud of splinters adds to the pellets and pins the foe.

name: Ironbead
description: Drive a hardened pattern into a foe's shield so its face cracks under the weight.

name: Waning Pellet
description: Sense the seams of a foe's armour with qi and aim the heart of the pattern at them.

name: Mayhem Pump
description: Release a full pattern that shatters a barricade and scatters its splinters across the foes behind.

name: Lot Bead
description: Fire three patterns along one fracture line so each opens the way for the next.

name: Remnant Wad
description: Read the hinges and the bar of a door and mark where a shot will tear it open.

name: Hastening Pattern
description: Close on a barred door in a low quick run with the muzzle already upon its hinge.

name: Blazeblast
description: Fire at the hinge side of a door to tear it loose from its frame.

name: Choke Thrash
description: Fire into the dust beyond a broken door to hold the defenders back from it.

name: Blast Maelstrom
description: Concentrate qi into one close shot that bursts a hinge and the post that holds it.

name: Scorching Slugchamber
description: Fire a heavy spread along a door bar so the wood splits and the pellets pass through.

name: Aegisshell
description: Turn the shoulder to the bursting door and let qi take the flying wood.

name: Siltshell
description: Drive a qi-heavy charge into a barred door so it bursts inward upon the defenders.

name: Scything Breech
description: Aim at the mortar seam of a thin wall and drive qi-laden pellets through to the room behind.

name: Veritybead
description: Judge the width of a lane and decide how tight to shape the spread before firing.

name: Silt Pattern
description: Walk with the shoulder brushing the wall so the muzzle always points down the lane.

name: Downpour Shell
description: Fire straight down a lane so the pellets sweep from wall to wall.

name: Nova Sawnedge
description: Round a corner with the muzzle first and fire at the first foe in view.

name: Gust Buckshot
description: Backpedal down the lane recharging as the foes follow into the open.

name: Thorn Doublebarrel
description: Crouch against the wall so the piece and the body offer little to a foe's spear.

name: Breechassault
description: Fire and fall back step by step so a rolling cloud of pellets fills the lane.

name: Pellet Torment
description: Shape the spread tall and thin so it fills the lane and wastes nothing upon the walls.

name: Waning Pumpgrip
description: Read the echo of footfalls in a lane through qi and fire at the nearest.

name: Siltchoke
description: Spend a held charge in a long sweeping blast that runs the whole length of a lane.

name: Spreadshot Cloak
description: Fire a thick curtain of pellets across an alley mouth so no foe dares cross it.

name: Intent Pellet
description: Load the two barrels in matched order so each carries the same powder and the same shot.

name: Discerning Shell
description: Cock both hammers in one motion of the thumb and lay the finger beside the trigger.

name: Glintchoke
description: Fire the first barrel at the nearest foe while the second stays loaded and silent.

name: Silt Blast
description: Step in time with the shots so each barrel is fired from a settled stance.

name: Blazeshell
description: Fire the second barrel at the foe who steps through the smoke of the first.

name: Slag Spreadshot
description: Fire both barrels so their fans cross and leave no gap before the muzzle.

name: Might Choke
description: Pass qi between the barrels so the second shot carries what the first left unspent.

name: Hollowchoke
description: Fire both barrels at one mark in the same breath so two qi-driven masses strike together.

name: Wrecking Doublebarrel
description: Sweep the paired barrels across a wide front in two linked spreads that flow into one another.

name: Fortifying Wad
description: Mark a foe from above his line with a hawk's patient eye and fix the muzzle there.

name: Resilient Slugchamber
description: Settle into a wide basin stance with qi pooled low so the kick sinks into the earth.

name: Slag Pumpgrip
description: Fire from the rim of a hollow down upon foes gathered in its bottom.

name: Gust Blast
description: Stoop forward in one swift step as a hawk drops upon its prey.

name: Gust Pump
description: Bend the line of aim with the foe's turn as a river bends round a rock and fire.

name: Might Bead
description: Recharge to a measured two-beat cadence so the hands never hurry and never fumble.

name: Harrowing Buckshot
description: Fire downward from a rise so the pellets drop upon the foe like a hawk's stoop.

name: Mayhem Pattern
description: Gather the pellets in a tight basin of qi that opens only at the foe.

name: Gust Sawnedge
description: Retreat in a flowing line that keeps the foes within the arc of the muzzle.

name: Mayhem Blast
description: Fire a burst high and bright so the foes' eyes are drawn up and their formation loosens.

name: Mayhemshell
description: Pour a cascade of spreads into a hollow so the foes within are struck from every side.

name: Needling Bead
description: Drive a qi-heavy load through the foe's guard like a river breaching its bank.

name: Waning Breech
description: Mark two foes at once and note which stands nearer to the muzzle.

name: Siltpump
description: Stalk along the river bank with the barrel low and the feet set by the slope.

name: Rumble Pattern
description: Fire at the nearer foe and swing at once toward the second.

name: Granite Slug
description: Fire a loose spread at the farther foe to hold him in place while the near one falls.

name: Thornchoke
description: Drop into reed cover so the foes lose the muzzle and the muzzle keeps the foes.

name: Intentwad
description: Flush two foes from cover with one spread and hold them with the next.

name: Drubbing Sawnedge
description: Drive two quick qi shots at paired foes so both are hit before either can turn.

name: Beadplating
description: Turn a charging foe along the bank line with a barrel parry and a close spread.

name: Intentbead
description: Chain two snap volleys at near and far marks so neither foe can aid the other.

name: Tempered Pumpgrip
description: Spring from reed cover to fire a qi-driven load that drops a foe before he sees the muzzle.
